sources.quote: operating without one has been prohibited since 1 July 2024
sources.title: Licensing temporary help agencies and recruiters | Your guide to the Employment Standards Act
sources.evidence: Beginning on July 1, 2024 under the Employment Standards Act, 2000, temporary help agencies are required to hold a licence to operate and recruiters are required to hold a licence to act as a recruiter. The prohibition on operating without a licence took effect on July 1, 2024.

sources.quote: An Ontario client is barred from knowingly engaging an unlicensed temporary help agency or recruiter
sources.title: Licensing temporary help agencies and recruiters | ontario.ca
sources.evidence: Clients are prohibited from knowingly engaging or using the services of a temporary help agency unless the agency holds a licence. Employers, prospective employers and other recruiters are prohibited from knowingly engaging or using the services of any recruiter that does not hold a licence.

sources.quote: must disclose expected compensation or a range, state whether artificial intelligence is used to screen applicants, and say whether the role is an existing vacancy
sources.title: Requirements related to publicly advertised job postings | Your guide to the Employment Standards Act
sources.evidence: As of January 1, 2026, employers are required to include in a publicly advertised job posting information about the expected compensation or range of compensation for the position, a statement disclosing the employer's use, if any, of artificial intelligence to screen, assess or select applicants, and a statement disclosing whether a vacancy exists or not. The requirements do not apply to employers with fewer than 25 employees.

sources.quote: age, gender, marital status and parental status cannot be used to target employment ads, and granular location targeting is limited
sources.title: Employment in personalized advertising - Advertising Policies Help
sources.evidence: Certain demographics (age, gender, marital status, parental status) may not be used to target Employment ads in the United States and Canada. ZIP code location targeting cannot be used for Employment ads in the United States and Canada; radius targeting requires at least 1 km.

sources.quote: Meta applies an equivalent special ad category, so the demographic targeting a home services business relies on is closed to you
sources.title: About audiences for credit, employment or housing campaigns | Meta Business Help Centre
sources.evidence: For advertisers targeting audiences in the US, Canada and certain European countries, special ad category audiences must include ages 18-65 and all genders, and these options cannot be edited. Some demographic, behaviour and interest options are unavailable, and excluding any detailed targeting selections is also unavailable.

sources.quote: Personnel placement and temporary foreign worker recruitment agencies need a CNESST permit, client businesses are expected to verify it in the public register of permit holders
sources.publisher: CNESST (Commission des normes, de l’équité, de la santé et de la sécurité du travail)
sources.title: Personnel placement agency workers | Commission des normes de l'équité de la santé et de la sécurité du travail - CNESST
sources.evidence: A personnel placement agency must have a valid licence issued by the CNESST to carry on its activities in Québec. You can check if an agency is on the list of licenced agencies.

sources.quote: British Columbia has required expected pay or a range in public postings since 1 November 2023
sources.title: Pay transparency in B.C. - Province of British Columbia
sources.evidence: Effective November 1, 2023, B.C. employers are required to include salary or wage information on all publicly posted jobs under the Pay Transparency Act. Employers must include the expected pay or pay range in all public job postings.

sources.quote: a working unsubscribe honoured within ten business days
sources.title: Frequently Asked Questions about Canada's Anti-Spam Legislation | CRTC
sources.evidence: If someone uses the link to unsubscribe, you must process the request without delay, and no later than 10 business days after receiving it. Your unsubscribe link must remain valid for at least 60 days after you send a CEM.
